sources.content: # CLAUDE.md for Wispenrow. Wispenrow is a habit-tracking mobile app built with React Native 0.74 and TypeScript. Install dependencies with `pnpm install` and start the bundler with `pnpm start`. Run `pnpm ios` or `pnpm android` to launch a simulator build. Screens live in `src/screens/`, and shared components in `src/ui/`. State is managed with Zustand stores in `src/state/`. The minimum supported versions are iOS 15 and Android 8. Run `pnpm typecheck` to check types without building.

Rules. Every string shown to users goes through the `t()` helper and has an entry in `locales/en.json`; never hardcode copy. Run `pnpm test` (Jest) and `pnpm lint` before each commit. Do not touch `ios/Pods/` or `android/app/build/`; they are generated. Local notifications are scheduled only through `src/services/reminders.ts`. Any change to the database schema in `src/db/schema.ts` needs a new migration file in `src/db/migrations/`. Release builds are made by CI, never on a laptop.

claims.text: Wispenrow is built with React Native 0.74.
Wispenrow schedules local notifications only through src/services/reminders.ts.
Wispenrow release builds are made by CI.
Wispenrow keeps its Zustand stores in src/state/.
The minimum Android version Wispenrow supports is Android 8.
